name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_summary: Zero-balance basic savings bank deposit account with RuPay debit card, accident insurance cover, and overdraft facility for financial inclusion
benefit_amount: Accident insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh (Rs. 1 lakh for accounts opened before 28.8.2018); overdraft facility up to Rs. 10,000

name: National Pension System
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance (PFRDA)
benefit_summary: Voluntary defined-contribution pension account offering market-linked returns and tax benefits for retirement savings
benefit_amount: Market-linked returns; tax deduction up to Rs. 2 lakh under Section 80CCD

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
ministry: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
benefit_summary: Free additional foodgrains to NFSA ration card holders under Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) categories
benefit_amount: 5 kg foodgrain per person per month, free of cost

name: One Nation One Ration Card
ministry: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
benefit_summary: Portability of NFSA ration card foodgrain entitlement, allowing beneficiaries to draw rations from any Fair Price Shop in India via Aadhaar/biometric authentication
benefit_amount: As per existing ration card entitlement (AAY/PHH quota)

name: Ramai Awas Yojana
ministry: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Financial assistance for construction of a permanent house to homeless Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist families
benefit_amount: Rs. 1.32 lakh (rural), Rs. 1.42 lakh (hilly/Naxal-affected), Rs. 2.50 lakh (urban/municipal areas), plus Rs. 12,000 for toilet construction

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
ministry: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Monthly financial assistance (pension) to destitute persons
official_portal: and other vulnerable categories without means of support

name: Manodhairya Yojana
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
verified_at: Rs. 1 lakh to Rs. 10 lakh depending on severity of the case (as per revised 2024 Government Resolution)

name: Lek Ladki Yojana
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Direct financial assistance to a girl child born in yellow/orange ration card families
benefit_amount: disbursed in phases from birth until she turns 18
application_url: Total Rs. 1,01,000 disbursed in phases from birth to age 18

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Additional annual income support to PM-KISAN registered cultivable-landholding farmer families in Maharashtra
benefit_amount: Rs. 6,000 per year (Rs. 2,000 x 3 instalments), in addition to PM-KISAN's Rs. 6,000/year
